description:
Indépendant | Rémunération à la commission uniquement | Territoire de vente local | Commissions déplafonnées

À propos de l'opportunité

Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l'aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants.

En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d'opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route.

Vous devrez justifier d'une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp.

Vos missions

  • Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes.
  • Cibler les entreprises locales générant d'importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp.
  • Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels.
  • Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat.
  • Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp.
  • Établir des relations avec les chefs d'entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits.
  • Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d'optimiser votre temps sur le terrain.
  • Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes.
  • Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux.

Ce que nous recherchons

Indispensable

  • Au moins un an d'expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l'énergie, les technologies d'entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l'approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons.
  • Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.
  • Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.
  • Des résultats démontrables en matière d'acquisition de nouveaux clients et d'atteinte d'objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu.
  • La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections.
  • Un bon sens de l'organisation et un suivi rigoureux.
  • La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d'expérience et à persévérer.
  • Une bonne compréhension du statut d'indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients.
  • La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients.

Atouts

  • Un réseau existant de chefs d'entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp.
  • Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente.

Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain.

Rémunération

Il s'agit d'une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l'activité des commerçants apportés.

Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner :

  • Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions.
  • Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème.
  • Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème.
  • Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans.
  • Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois.
  • Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales.

Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d'activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s'appliquer.

Les conditions d'éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s'entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables.

Formation et accompagnement

Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l'accompagnement des clients.

Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage.

Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d'analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d'organisation.

Commercial terrain, Commercial itinérant, Sales, Freelance, Vente, Commercial B2B, Commercial indépendant, Développement commercial.

 

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

description:
The Role

Intellect delivers a clinically governed mental health programme to enterprise clients in the mining and resources sector, supporting remote and expatriate workforces. This is not a standard EAP. Cases begin with acute risk assessment on remote sites and run through structured treatment, fitness-for-work assessment and return-to-work clearance, in direct coordination with the client's chaplaincy, medical and people teams.

This role covers the client's United Kingdom operations and a West African project site where the working language is French. It is a combined clinical delivery and case management role: the postholder conducts the assessments, delivers the therapy, writes the reports and owns the case, rather than coordinating a provider network. That design reflects the absence of an established provider network in the West African market at launch, and gives the client a single clinician who knows each case end to end.

Full professional fluency in French and English is a non-negotiable requirement. Welfare calls, clinical assessment, case documentation and client communication in the West African market are conducted in French.

Responsibilities

Clinical assessment and delivery

  • Conduct acute risk and welfare assessments for employees referred through the client's escalation pathway, in French or English as required.
  • Deliver individual counselling and psychotherapy across the supported caseload, virtually.
  • Conduct fitness-for-work assessments and produce the associated clinical documentation.
  • Write risk assessments, session documentation, return-to-work memoranda and fitness-for-work reports to a standard that stands up to client and regulatory scrutiny, in the language the case requires.
  • Delivery is capped so that case management availability is protected. Session load is agreed with the Head of Clinical Operations and reviewed as volume changes.

Case management and coordination

  • Own each case end to end, from referral through assessment, treatment, fitness-for-work and reintegration to closure.
  • Align the initial support plan with the client's on-site teams, including session volume and cadence, and manage adjustments where clinically indicated.
  • Coordinate with internal helpline, care excellence and network partnership teams on anything that cannot be delivered directly.
  • Review the open case list for stalled items and follow up to keep cases moving.

Clinical risk oversight and governance

  • Confirm risk tiering against the client's framework and set review cadence and monitoring requirements.
  • Make the clinical decisions the pathway requires, including disputed risk ratings and medical evaluation pathways where an employee declines therapy.
  • Escalate to the Head of Clinical Operations where a case exceeds the scope of remote delivery or requires in-person intervention.
  • Work within the differing regulatory, medical and emergency-escalation environments of each market, and flag where local pathways do not support the agreed protocol.

Clinical protocols and client enablement

  • Co-develop and maintain the clinical protocols, risk frameworks and SOPs the client's on-site teams operate to, including French-language versions.
  • Design and deliver clinical training and framework guidance to client-side staff who are not clinicians, in French and English.
  • Build out the in-market provider network alongside Network Partnerships, so that in-person and overflow capacity exists as the programme scales.

Client relationship, insights and reporting

  • Act as the named clinical contact for the client's chaplaincy, medical and health and safety leads in both markets, responding within the core window to queries that are frequently unscheduled and time-critical.
  • Produce the case tracker and monthly clinical reporting, moving beyond utilisation to presenting issues, risk patterns, outcomes and service-level themes.
  • Present clinical insight at client review meetings and translate it into recommendations the client's health and safety and people teams can act on.

Requirements

  • Full professional fluency in French and English, to the standard required for clinical assessment, therapy delivery and client-facing documentation in both languages.
  • Registered clinical psychologist or qualified counsellor, with current registration in your jurisdiction and the right to practise remotely.
  • Master's degree in clinical psychology, counselling or a related field.
  • Minimum three years in clinical practice, including direct delivery of assessment and therapy to adults.
  • Demonstrable experience managing acute risk, including suicidality, in a setting where you held the decision rather than advised on it.
  • Experience of structured return-to-work, fitness-for-work or occupational mental health pathways.
  • Able to work four hours a day, Monday to Friday, within the 08:00 to 17:00 UK and West Africa window.

Desirable

  • Experience working across multiple jurisdictions or with expatriate, rotational or multinational workforces.
  • Understanding of remote industrial, mining, resources or energy operating environments.
  • Additional language capability, particularly Mandarin.
  • Experience contributing to clinical protocols, risk frameworks or SOPs.
  • Prior case management or clinical account experience in a commercial setting.

Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants.

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Envie d’imaginer la suite de cette histoire à nos côtés ? Ecrivez-nous !

Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Conseiller(e) de vente (H/F) en CDI, pour rejoindre notre équipe de la Samaritaine. Ce poste est basé à La Samaritaine à Paris (75).

Rattaché(e) au Directeur de l’Appartement, vos principales responsabilités seront : 

Délivrer une expérience client singulière : 

  • Faire du client la priorité de l’appartement pour garantir un service client optimal ;
  • Incarner l’esprit et le style Sézane par une présentation impeccable (respect du grooming) ;
  • Accueillir vos clients avec générosité et empathie afin de leur offrir la meilleure expérience possible ;
  • Considérer la personnalité de vos Clients afin d'identifier ses désirs ;
  • Faire découvrir la Marque et nos différents univers/ produits ;
  • Etre ambassadeur de l'omnicanalité de la Marque (appartement et web) ;
  • Faire preuve de curiosité et développer une connaissance approfondie de la Marque et des produits ;
  • Être force de proposition d’actions spécifiques pour rendre l’expérience client mémorable et unique ;
  • Traiter les réclamations et insatisfactions clients pour satisfaire et fidéliser nos clients ;
  • Connaître notre politique RSE pour répondre aux clients.

Garantir l’image de Marque : 

  • Connaître les règles de bases du merchandising Sézane ;
  • Vérifier l’étiquetage des produits sur le floor ;
  • Participer à l’implantation du merchandising et veiller à son suivi ;
  • Offrir aux clients une expérience shopping passionnante et inspirante ;
  • Suivre et maintenir le niveau commercial du point de vente ;
  • Avoir une culture mode pour être force de propositions.

Veiller au bon déroulement des Opérations : 

  • Appliquer les politiques, Standards et procédures Sézane ;
  • Encaisser et respecter les procédures liées aux opérations ;
  • Effectuer les process de traitements spécifiques (retours, échanges, réservations) ;
  • Participer à la définition des effectifs nécessaires pour répondre aux attentes clients ;
  • Garantir la bonne gestion des stocks.

Avoir un esprit d’équipe :

  • Etre Team-player, participer à toutes les tâches annexes ;
  • Participer à la création d’un environnement positif et harmonieux pour créer une synergie de groupe ;
  • Relayer les engagements de la marque.

Requirements

  • Vous avez une première expérience réussie en prêt à porter, en hôtellerie, en restauration, en vente, en animation… ou pas encore, mais êtes animé par le relationnel client?
  • Vous avez le sens du service, une excellente présentation et une forte sensibilité mode ;
  • Vous avez l’esprit d’équipe, l’envie de partager et développer vos compétences dans un environnement agile et galvanisant ;
  •  Vous n’aimez pas vous ennuyer car vous débordez d’énergie?

Sézane recrute et valorise tous les talents, quels que soient votre genre, âge, nationalité, culture, croyances religieuses et orientations sexuelles.

Vous vous êtes reconnu(e) dans ce descriptif et souhaitez rejoindre l’aventure Sézane ? Alors n’attendez plus !

title: Deployment Strategist - Crypto Investigations
description:
Global Services helps Chainalysis customers turn blockchain data and investigative tools into practical results. Our customers include law enforcement, national security teams, financial institutions, and organisations across the crypto industry.

We’re looking for a Deployment Strategist, Crypto Investigations, to join Global Services and support public-sector customers in France, particularly law enforcement and intelligence teams. You’ll use your investigative experience and technical skills to help customers get the most out of Chainalysis products. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role focused on investigations and practical problem-solving rather than software engineering.

You’ll work with customers throughout their engagement with Chainalysis, from understanding their needs and conducting investigations to developing workflows, delivering training, and helping them build their own capabilities. You’ll need sound investigative judgement, strong French communication skills, and the ability to build trusted relationships with customers.


In this role, you’ll:

  • Support customer engagements from initial discovery and pre-sales through investigations, solution delivery, training, and ongoing support

  • Conduct blockchain investigations using Chainalysis products, particularly Reactor

  • Work with law enforcement, intelligence, and other public-sector customers to understand their objectives and help them achieve practical results

  • Build and adapt investigative workflows, queries, reports, and dashboards using Chainalysis tools and data

  • Help customers put investigative workflows into practice and develop the skills to use Chainalysis independently

  • Build trusted customer relationships by providing practical investigative guidance and product expertise

  • Lead customer meetings, demonstrations, investigative walkthroughs, training sessions, and technical briefings

  • Support pre-sales discussions by understanding customer requirements and explaining how Chainalysis can help

  • Share customer feedback and investigative insights with Product, Engineering, Global Intel, and Sales

  • Share investigative techniques and best practices with colleagues across Global Services

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • Experience conducting or supporting investigations in law enforcement, policing, intelligence, or a related field. Candidates with relevant crypto or financial-crime investigation experience from other backgrounds will also be considered

  • Experience working with public-sector, law-enforcement, intelligence, or other mission-focused stakeholders

  • Strong investigative judgement and the ability to explain findings clearly and build credibility with customers

  • The technical aptitude to learn investigative platforms and work with data; extensive software-engineering experience is not required

  • The ability to analyse complex information and communicate findings to both investigators and senior stakeholders

  • The flexibility to work across pre-sales, customer delivery, and ongoing support

  • Fluency in French, with the ability to work confidently with French-speaking customers

  • The ability to be based in France, ideally in Paris

Required Skills

Technical Skills

  • Confidence using investigative tools and the ability to develop expertise in Chainalysis Reactor

  • Ability to work with investigative data and turn customer requirements into practical workflows, queries, and reports

  • Familiarity with blockchain investigation tools or analytical workflows is an advantage; Python and SQL are not required

  • Ability to learn Chainalysis products and understand how their data can support customer investigations

Domain Expertise

  • Experience in law enforcement, policing, intelligence, financial crime, or another relevant investigative field

  • Understanding of investigative objectives, operational workflows, and the outcomes customers need to achieve

  • Ability to use investigative judgement to guide an investigation and advise customers on their approach

Customer & Communication Skills

  • Ability to build trusted customer relationships through investigative knowledge and practical support

  • Excellent spoken and written French, including the ability to explain complex investigative concepts clearly

  • Confidence leading customer meetings, briefings, demonstrations, and training sessions

  • Ability to help customers develop their own skills and use Chainalysis tools independently

Day to Day Activities

  • Conduct investigations using Chainalysis tools, primarily Reactor, based on customer requirements

  • Prepare investigative reports, workflows, queries, and other analytical outputs

  • Work directly with customers to develop and implement investigative workflows

  • Deliver hands-on training, walkthroughs, and knowledge-sharing sessions

  • Lead demonstrations, investigative briefings, and solution presentations

  • Support pre-sales discussions, technical discovery, and solution scoping

  • Gather customer feedback and share practical recommendations with Product, Engineering, and Global Intel

  • Manage multiple customer engagements while maintaining quality and responsiveness

  • Continue developing knowledge of blockchain investigations and emerging crypto-related threats

Personal Attributes

  • Curious about blockchain technology, crypto crime, and investigative techniques

  • Able to communicate clearly and adapt to different audiences

  • Comfortable taking ownership and making sound decisions in situations where the path forward may not be clear

  • Collaborative and willing to work across teams

  • Keen to develop specialist knowledge and share it with others

Nice to have experience: [icing on the cake, not a deal breaker]

  • Previous experience using Chainalysis products

  • Experience with cryptocurrency investigations, blockchain analytics, or financial-crime analysis

  • Experience in traditional finance or financial investigations

  • Experience providing expert evidence or supporting legal proceedings

  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as BSA/AML, sanctions screening, MiCA, or the Travel Rule

  • Experience with data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or cloud-based analytics tools

  • Published research, intelligence reports, or other work relating to blockchain analytics or financial crime

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

title: Computer Vision Engineer (VIO)
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

We are looking for a Computer Vision Engineer to contribute to the development of the front-end of our visual inertial odometry (VIO) algorithmic stack.

 

Responsibilities

  • VIO Front-end Algorithm development:

    • Matching between frames and stereo pairs

    • Calibration of cameras intrinsic and extrinsic parameters

    • Detection of obstruction

  • Implementation and optimization of the algorithmic stack for our embedded platforms

  • Testing, Validation & Monitoring: algorithms testing in simulation and real-world environments, development of inspection and monitoring tools..

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with system engineers, optical engineers, software engineers. Communicate findings effectively to stakeholders.

 

Candidate Requirements

  • Educational Background: Master’s degree in Robotics, Physics, Computer Science or related field, PhD is a plus

  • Technical Expertise: Strong mathematical foundations, coding skills in both Python and C++

  • Hands-on VIO project experience. Experience with VIO on industrial products is a huge plus.

  • Passion for Computer Vision and Robotics

  • Strong Communication & Teamwork: Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan’s mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a fast-growing Swiss AI and data analytics consulting and services company dedicated to solving complex problems of traditional industries like automotive, chemical, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We work with some of the biggest organizations in Europe to solve the challenges that directly affect their business - be it operations, finance, manufacturing or R&D. Since our foundation, we have successfully delivered more than 300 projects and have grown to 190+ talented individuals across 10 office locations.


Unit8’s mission is to drive the adoption of AI and Data Science in the non-digital industries and to help accelerate their digital transformation. Among its activities, Unit8 dedicates a part of its resources and time on projects that deeply matter to us - that includes collaboration on pro-bono and “engineering for good” causes.

Requirements

What You’ll Do

Unit8 is welcoming young graduates for the opportunity to grow in Data and Software Engineering! Join us for a 6-month paid professional experience in building industrial Data and AI solutions. You can start asap, with direct exposure to clients' needs and opportunities to participate in learning activities such as Reading Groups and Knowledge Sharing Sessions. In addition, each young graduate will be accompanied by a dedicated wingmate/mentor who will guide and help them build their technical growth vision.


As a young graduate you will join a team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers and Cloud Engineers who work hand-in-hand with our customers on designing and implementing their industry-specific use cases. You will be directly involved in discussing the client’s challenges and needs and will have chances to develop your client-facing skills. You will be responsible for developing, deploying, and automating our AI services and cloud infrastructure. You will also learn to carefully analyse a given problem and apply the relevant tools and techniques to solve it.

In general you will:

  • use software best practices in continuous integration and delivery, versioning and automation;
  • use your skills to build and maintain service and data infrastructure;
  • participate as junior engineer in all phases of the software development life cycle - planning, implementation, deployment, testing and maintenance;

Are You the team member we are looking for?

In order to be successful in this role, you are/have:

  • motivated and eager to learn different aspects of engineering
  • comfortable interacting with technical and business people
  • strong communication and presentation skills
  • recently graduated/finishing your MSc or BSc in Computer Science or related major;
  • familiar with version control and collaboration tooling (git)
  • familiar with CI/CD frameworks and automated deployment concepts (i.e Docker, K8s)
  • fluent in both English and German
  • available for a minimum of 32h a week.
  • ready to start on the 1st of February

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Exposure to a wide variety of projects, industries, and technologies. Each client is different and provides unique opportunities to learn.
  • Ability to contribute to internal open-source projects like Darts (https://github.com/unit8co/darts)
  • Learning activities such as ML Reading Group, knowledge sharing sessions with engineers.
  • Training-on-the-job and your personal wingmate/mentor
  • 15 paid days of holiday
  • Be part of an international team of more than 20 nationalities.
  • up to 10% of paid time for self-development.
  • Flexible working hours, including some home office.
  • Cross offices/company-wide frequent events like offsites.
  • If you are successful, opportunity to be then hired for a permanent position.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
IN SHORT

Are you a versatile problem-solver who wants to write software that impacts the physical world? As a Full Stack Software Engineer (100%) in Zurich, you will be at the core of our operations, building systems that touch everything from warehouse automation to customer-facing smart fridges.


YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Take ownership of warehouse and supplier web apps used daily for inbound processing, picking, labeling, and inventory.
  • Develop and maintain our internal back-office tool, including the backend and GraphQL API that runs menus, deliveries, inventory, and customer sites.
  • Manage the service connecting automated picking lanes to the rest of the system to ensure uninterrupted warehouse operations.
  • Maintain and update the Point of Sale Android app running on hundreds of fridges, managing the release process for the entire fleet.
  • Integrate and support payment systems (Card, TWINT), our ERP, and other partner integrations.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation to debug live issues directly alongside the operations team.
  • Visit the warehouse on-site to test changes and gather feedback from the people actually using the software.
  • Translate vague problems from non-technical colleagues into shipped solutions without needing them broken down first.
  • Own production deployments, managing logs, alerts, and careful rollouts with clear rollback plans.
  • Break down larger features, review other engineers' pull requests, and proactively maintain system health through upgrades, testing, and cleanup.


YOUR PROFILE

  • Proven production experience in at least one typed backend language (such as C#, Java, Kotlin, Go, or TypeScript) and one modern frontend framework.
  • Track record of successfully owning software in production, including on-call duties, debugging from logs, and resolving live issues while users wait.
  • Familiarity with or willingness to dive into C#, TypeScript, Android, and Kotlin.
  • Prior exposure to hardware, IoT, edge devices, payments, logistics, retail operations, or Odoo environments is highly advantageous.
  • Demonstrated ability to dive into unfamiliar tech stacks, learn quickly, and ship reliable code.
  • Strong passion for collaborating directly with end-users, including warehouse and operations staff, rather than exclusively with other engineers.
  • High degree of curiosity and a proactive mindset to take full ownership of problems from end to end.
  • Fluent English communication skills (written and spoken); knowledge of German or French is a plus.
  • Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.
  • Valid work permit or Swiss passport.


OUR BENEFITS

  • Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk - we make your gastronomic dreams come true
  • Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine
  • 5 weeks holiday per year, as well as the chance to buy an extra week of vacation 
  • Two full weeks of ‘work from anywhere’ per year to bring more variety to your work day
  • We care about your future with an above-mandatory pension fund

description:
Wenn Du gerne selbständig arbeitest, fasziniert von digitalen Anwendungen bist, Ideen einbringst und deine Patienten langfristig und engmaschig betreuen möchtest, dann bist Du bei Oviva genau richtig! Bei uns stehst Du im Mittelpunkt

Für den weiteren Ausbau unseres Oviva-ErnährungsberaterInnen-Netzwerks suchen wir dich per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung als ambulante Remote Ernährungsberater*in BSc 50-100% (a).

Warum Oviva?

Bei Oviva verfolgen wir eine klare Mission: Wir wollen eine nachhaltige, personalisierte und klinisch wirksame Versorgung für alle zugänglich machen.

Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen mit gewichtsbedingten Erkrankungen. Für viele ist Gewichtsverlust ein Ziel, doch unser Ansatz geht weit darüber hinaus: Wir helfen, die Gesundheit zu verbessern, Selbstvertrauen aufzubauen und die Lebensqualität zu steigern.

Wir haben bereits über eine Million Menschen in der Schweiz, Deutschland, Polen und Grossbritannien unterstützt – und wir stehen erst am Anfang. Jedes Gespräch, jedes Coaching und jede Zeile Code bringt uns einer gesünderen Zukunft näher. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte diese Zukunft aktiv mit.


Die Rolle

Als Remote Ernährungsberater*in BSc (a) bietest du qualitativ hochwertige, digitale Ernährungsberatung für Patientinnen und Patienten im Rahmen unseres integrierten Gesundheit Ökosystems an. In dieser Rolle arbeitest du zu 100 % im Homeoffice. Du konzentrierst dich voll und ganz auf die direkte, virtuelle Betreuung sowie den engen interdisziplinären Austausch mit unserem medizinischen Fachpersonal (Ärztinnen und Ärzte, Psychotherapeut/-innen sowie Medizinische Praxisassistent/-innen).

Dein Verantwortungsbereich

  • Virtuelle Patientenbetreuung: Durchführung von ambulanter Ernährungsberatung im 100%igen Remote-Setting sowie selbstständige und effiziente Gestaltung deines digitalen Kalenders.

  • Pflege der Behandlungsdossiers: Sorgfältige und zeitnahe Dokumentation aller Therapieverläufe über unsere Plattformen (u. a. OCS und Tomedo).

  • Pfadkonforme Therapie: Konsequente Umsetzung unserer definierten Versorgungs- und Behandlungspfade (Oviva Clinic CH Dietetics Pathway).

  • Interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit: Aktive Teilnahme an regelmässigen Fallbesprechungen und Rapporten mit Ärztinnen, Ärzten, Psychotherapeut/-innen und MPAs zur Sicherung einer ganzheitlichen Patientenversorgung.

  • Qualität & Entwicklung: Regelmässiger Austausch mit deiner Teamleitung sowie Teilnahme an virtuellen Teammeetings und internen Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.

Das bringst du mit

  • Qualifikation: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Ernährungswissenschaften / Ernährungsberatung (FH oder Bachelor BFH / FFHS) oder eine entsprechende Schweizer SRK-Anerkennung eines ausländischen Diploms.

  • Bewilligung: Eine gültige Berufsausübungsbewilligung (BAB) für deinen Wohnkanton ab dem ersten Arbeitstag.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Muttersprachliche oder fliessende Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch, Französisch oder Italienisch; solide Arbeitskenntnisse in Englisch sind von Vorteil.

  • Digitale Affinität: Begeisterung für das Arbeiten im 100%igen Remote-Setting und Erfahrung mit digitaler Videokommunikation sowie der parallelen Nutzung verschiedener Software-Systeme.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Freude am täglichen, vertrauensvollen Austausch mit Patientinnen und Patienten sowie im interdisziplinären Team.

Was von Vorteil ist:

  • Erfahrung in der Beratung von Patientinnen und Patienten mit Adipositas und gewichtsbezogenen Erkrankungen (inkl. moderner Therapieformen wie GLP-1-Medikamenten).

  • Zusatzausbildung oder fundiertes Verständnis im Bereich Ernährungspsychologie.

  • Erfahrung in der digital unterstützten Gesundheitsversorgung (Digital Health).

  • Ein interessantes und abwechslungsreiches Aufgabengebiet mit gezielter Einarbeitung in einem innovativem Geschäftsumfeld (Digital Health)

  • Ein unbefristete Festanstellung mit viel Flexibilität bezüglich Arbeitszeit, -pensum und -ort sowie Möglichkeit im Home Office zu arbeiten

  • Ein dynamisches, aufgeschlossenes und humorvolles Team, welches gemeinsam Erfolge feiert und Wissen untereinander teilt

  • Eine innovative, eigenentwickelte Software zur Datenverwaltung und Dokumentation sowie Kommunikation mit deinen Patienten

  • Attraktive Benefits wie ein persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget, Kauf von zusätzlichen Ferientagen sowie fortschrittliche Konditionen bei der beruflichen Vorsorge

About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to rapid growth in our partner lab network, we are seeking a Scientific Product Manager to join our Product team and bring partner labs and their experimental workflows onto the CuspAI platform.

Your impact

This is an exciting opportunity to join the product team at CuspAI, working closely with materials scientists, ML researchers and platform engineers to make AI-driven experimentation work in real laboratories. As one of a small team of Scientific Product Managers, you will take ownership of a set of partner labs and the lab integration work around them, translating what each lab actually needs into requirements our engineers and ML researchers can build against. Alongside the product work, you will spend real time with your partners' teams and their experimental data.

Who we're looking for

We are looking for a hands-on Quality Platform Lead to own Vio's quality strategy and automation platform across web, mobile, browser extensions, internal tooling and related surfaces.

This is a technical leadership role (Staff IC) reporting to the Director of Engineering. You define what good looks like for quality, decide where scarce testing effort goes, and give teams the confidence to ship. Your levers are release gates, quality telemetry, and a developer experience that makes the right tests easy to write and keep alive.

Product engineers own the tests for the features they build. Your remit is the platform, the strategy and the enablement that make that work hold up at scale. There is no QA department here and we have no plans to create one.

  • Web: Playwright, Checkly, BrowserStack

AI-assisted tooling is an open area too. We have no established practice for agent-generated tests or AI-assisted triage, so your judgment on what earns a place in the platform carries real weight.

What we lack today is clear ownership of strategy, release gates and shared quality telemetry, plus a low-friction path for engineers to spend their testing effort on the highest-risk scenarios.

How the role works

Your time splits between hands-on platform work, enablement, strategy and stakeholder telemetry. One insourced QA Engineer supports you. You own the technical direction, the standards and the quality outcomes.

Once the platform has low friction, product engineers write and maintain the tests for the domains they own. You enable that through patterns, docs, reusable modules, CI checks and risk-based guidance. Gatekeeping releases sits outside the role.

Expect no direct people-management responsibilities in the near future. Any further QE hire gets evaluated against the ~1:50 rule once the value is proven, and we have no committed headcount plan beyond that.

What you'll own

Quality strategy and platform

  • Own the quality strategy and the automation platform across products, covering direction, standards and day-to-day health

Release gates and telemetry

  • Put failure triage and flaky-test quarantine in place, so every failure is worth acting on

Risk-based coverage and testability

  • Work with Product and Engineering to protect high-impact journeys and APIs

  • Retire flaky and low-value tests, and concentrate effort where the risk is highest

  • Act as the technical stakeholder for testability (hooks, mocks, contract tests, test data) and get those improvements onto team roadmaps

Developer enablement

Trade-offs we accept: depth on one platform when the other is learnable, and no travel or booking domain background.
